tags.freshNeedsMerc: I: true refuses a fresh game while the merc is left dead (survfix2); false (card survtune): the margin already counts the dead merc, so a pick that is eligible without him is as safe in a fresh game of the same zone, and the refusal kept the margin arm farming 24 xp/min zones for an hour while the legacy arm recycled the game (the rerun of seed 113: 27k xp against 52k), U
tags.starveCasts: I: decayed count of mana-starved watchdog lines in a zone that lowers its value (26 lines in 41 minutes in the screen), U

tags.yieldStarveRatio: I: card survhold7: a zone whose realized xp/min stayed below this share of the model prior over yieldStarveMinutes stay minutes is worth what it paid (no blend floor) times yieldStarveMul; 0 = off (global default off; the caster row is on), seed 211 margin: BG model 152, realized 5-8 for 25 minutes, U
tags.unvisitedFloor: I: card survhold7: zones with no realized data have their prior xp/min multiplied by the minutes-weighted realized/prior ratio of the zones that have it, never below this floor and never above 1, and only when that ratio is under unvisitedBelow; 0 = off (caster row on), seed 211: Mausoleum/Crypt priors 160/165 after BG realized 7, U
tags.casterYield: card survhold3: caster yieldMinMinutes 1.5 (realized yield counts after 1.5 minutes, not 3) and starveValueMul 0.25; a starved zone's xp is also capped at what it realized (seed 103: realized 6 xp/min against a model 152), U
tags.dials: card survtune: typicalEnter, badFloor and riskValueMul are the pay-for-risk route (the 8-seed Paladin A/B lost 18 percent XP with 10 chickens against 36 for the legacy arm; the margin arm sat in 60 xp/min zones while the bad pack of the 440 xp/min zone read 0.8 to 2.4): a zone the bad pack calls too tight is entered when the typical pack is at least typicalEnter and the bad pack's corrected best margin at least badFloor; its value is multiplied by riskValueMul. riskMinGold (card survhold: seed 149 of the holdout burned 25 potions in 6 minutes in a risk-route zone with 100 to 290 gold and went broke, then chickened its way through recovery) closes the route below that pack gold, 0 = no condition. All four are U until the rerun; 0 turns the route off (cautious). Step-down rows: design 5.2 'observed cost that forces a step down': either = chickens plus merc deaths in the window, deaths = deaths in the window; 0 turns the row off. U
